title: Third-party API rate limit exceeded
symptoms: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests from the payment provider. Rate limit exceeded, retry after 60 seconds. Calls to one external API fail in bursts.
root_cause: Our calls exceed the provider's quota, often because of a retry storm or a traffic spike.
impact: Features that depend on that API fail or slow down.
fix_steps: Check our outbound call rate to the provider.
Add backoff with jitter to retries.
Ask the provider for a higher limit if the traffic is real.
prevention: Client-side rate limiting and caching of provider responses.
